speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Mesenteric Ischemia. Given your recent acute myocardial infarction, the sudden onset of pain out of proportion to physical exam, and bloody stools, this is highly suggestive of acute mesenteric ischemia. I need to confirm this immediately with a CT angiogram of the abdomen and pelvis. REQUEST TEST: CT_Angiogram_Abdomen_Pelvis. REQUEST IMAGES
